final: WITH j AS (SELECT e.type AS type, b.amount - b.spent AS diff FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id), g AS (SELECT type, AVG(diff) AS rem_avg, AVG(diff) AS diff_avg FROM j GROUP BY type), o AS (SELECT AVG(diff_avg) AS overall_avg FROM g), kept AS (SELECT g.rem_avg, g.diff_avg, g.diff_avg - o.overall_avg AS gap FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.diff_avg > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(rem_avg), AVG(diff_avg), AVG(gap) FROM kept
